data.title: 奥萝拉 · 星屑消散前的深情一吻
data.description: 星光弥漫的遗迹虚空中，奥萝拉的身躯泛起晶莹光粒开始缓缓消散。她双手环抱住暗影的脖颈，眼角噙着释怀的浅笑，献上深情而虚幻的告别之吻。
data.location: cosmic void filled with drifting starry motes and ancient glowing glyphs
data.action: embracing Shadow neck closely as her lower body dissolves into sparkling light particles, smiling tenderly with closed eyes in a gentle kiss
data.lighting: soft luminescent stardust glow enveloping the embracing couple
data.mood: poignant bittersweet farewell, transcendent eternal bond, profound romantic peace
data.promptProse: In a starry cosmic void, black-haired witch Aurora dissolves into glowing particles while sharing a gentle tender farewell kiss.
data.animaCaption: Aurora sharing a tender farewell embrace as her spirit dissolves into stardust.
